issue.title: did.kr: narrow `||did.kr^$third-party` in Tracking Protection to track.did.kr and analytics.did.kr
issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);
- [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue;
- [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue.

### What product do you use?

AdGuard Browser Extension

### AdGuard version

5.5.4.82

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Website or app doesn't work properly

### Which browser(s) do you use?

Chrome

### Which device do you use?

Desktop

### Where is the problem encountered?

https://did.kr/

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

AdGuard Tracking Protection filter, AdGuard URL Tracking filter

### Social Widgets

_No response_

### Annoyances

_No response_

### Security

_No response_

### Other

Filter unblocking search ads and self-promotion

### DNS filters

_No response_

### Language-specific

_No response_

### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

did.kr provides a chat widget that businesses embed on their own websites. The Tracking Protection rule `||did.kr^$third-party` blocks the whole domain, so on those sites the chat widget cannot open.

Reproduced with AdGuard Browser Extension 5.5.4.82 (AdGuard Tracking Protection filter 2.1.16.18) on a site that embeds the widget: the chat shows an error and its requests to did.kr are blocked. Disabling AdGuard fixes it. We can share an example site privately if needed. Browser: Chrome 156, macOS.

All tracking from the widget now goes to separate hosts. The widget requests that remain on did.kr and cdn.did.kr only run the widget:

- Tracking: track.did.kr, analytics.did.kr
- Widget: did.kr, cdn.did.kr

Could `||did.kr^$third-party` be replaced with `||track.did.kr^$third-party` and `||analytics.did.kr^$third-party`? Visitors stay protected from tracking, and the widget keeps working.

### Privacy

- [x] I agree to follow this condition

issue.title: kr.tradingview.com
issue.body:
### Issue URL (Annoyance)
[https://kr.tradingview.com/chart/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fkr.tradingview.com%2Fchart%2F)

### Comment
> In the TradingView Desktop App for Windows (Electron app), a new Black Friday promo popup keeps appearing and blocks the chart.
> It appears both periodically (every 1-2 minutes) and immediately when selecting a drawing tool (such as a trendline) and drawing it on the chart.
> It has no close button and cannot be dismissed without reloading the tab, and it started bypassing AdGuard for Windows filters on November 23-24, 2026.
> Please block this intrusive popup modal in the Annoyances/Popups filter.



### Screenshots
<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/15lfiei87fj4ccwk04scwocwgosg40890b2u1y8qu4.png?nc=1)
</details>


### System configuration

| Information | Value |
|-------------|-------|
AdGuard product: | AdGuard for Windows v8.0.4
Browser: | TradingView Desktop App
AdGuard driver: | WFP
Tracking protection: | disabled
DNS filtering: | disabled
Browsing Security: | disabled
Browsing Security statistics: | disabled
Userscripts: | disabled
Userstyles: | disabled



### Issue configuration
[Import](https://reports.adguard.com/settings/import.html?product_type=win&product_version=8.0.4&system_version=&browser=other&browser_detail=TradingView+Desktop+App&dns.filters_enabled=false&dns.enabled=false&browsing_security.enabled=false&browsing_security.statistics_enabled=false&stealth.enabled=false&win.wfp=true)
